title: How US-based game publishers are losing ground in the $121B mobile gaming market to Chinese rivals, which can make games quicker, cheaper, and more profitably (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: How US-based game publishers are losing ground in the $121B mobile gaming market to Chinese rivals, which can make games quicker, cheaper, and more profitably — American studios are losing ground to Chinese rivals that can make games quicker, cheaper and more profitably.
